name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: yarn
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn build
      - run: yarn test

# Signature Maker Vue Vue 3 component that lets users draw, type or upload their signature and returns it as a PNG. A thin wrapper around the [signature-maker-js](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-js) web component. [Live demo](https://www.docuseal.com/online-signature) · [Documentation](https://www.docuseal.com/docs/embedded/signature#vue) · [JS](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-js) · [React](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-react) ## Installation ```bash npm install @docuseal/signature-maker-vue # or yarn add @docuseal/signature-maker-vue ``` Requires Vue 3.3 or newer. Works with server-side rendering. ## Usage No handlers needed: the Submit button downloads the signature as a PNG. ```vue ``` Handle the signature when the user clicks Submit: ```vue ``` Embed in a form without the Submit button. `v-model` holds the base64 PNG, or `null` while empty: ```vue ``` Restyle with CSS classes and translate the labels. A full DaisyUI example: ```vue ``` ## Events | Event | When | Argument | |---|---|---| | `save` | Submit button clicked | `{ base64, blob }` | | `change` | Signature drawn, typed, uploaded or cleared | `{ base64, blob }`, both `null` when empty | | `update:model-value` | Same as `change` | `base64` or `null`, drives `v-model` | A template ref gives access to the underlying element through `$el`, with `enableDrawPanel()`, `enableTextPanel()`, `enableUploadPanel()` and the [signature_pad](https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad) instance as `pad`. TypeScript declarations are included; the payload type is `SignatureDetail`: ```ts import type { SignatureDetail } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-vue' const handleSave = (detail: SignatureDetail) => console.log(detail.base64) ``` ## Props Behavior: | Prop | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `with-drawn` | `true` | Show the Draw tab | | `with-typed` | `true` | Show the Type tab | | `with-upload` | `true` | Show the Upload tab | | `with-color-select` | `true` | Show the pen color picker | | `with-submit` | `true` | Show the Submit button | | `download-on-save` | `false` | Download the PNG on Submit | | `font-url` | Dancing Script | WOFF font used for typed signatures | | `model-value` | `null` | Base64 PNG, use through `v-model` | Labels: `save-button-text`, `undo-button-text`, `clear-button-text`, `draw-type-button-text`, `text-type-button-text`, `upload-type-button-text`, `text-input-placeholder`. Styles: every element below accepts `-class` and `-style` (a CSS string). A class replaces the default inline styles, a style overrides them. State variants are appended to the base class or style. | Element | State variants | |---|---| | `save-button` | `save-button-disabled-class`, `save-buttons-disabled-style` | | `draw-type-button`, `text-type-button`, `upload-type-button` | `-active-class`, `-active-style` | | `undo-button`, `clear-button`, `text-input`, `canvas`, `type-buttons-container`, `control-buttons-container` | | Example: `draw-type-button-class="tab"` plus `draw-type-button-active-class="tab-active"` renders `class="tab tab-active"` while Draw is selected. ## License MIT

import path from 'node:path' import { build } from 'esbuild' import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test' const BUNDLE = path.join(__dirname, '../test-results/props-app.js') const BOOLEAN_PROPS = ['downloadOnSave', 'withTyped', 'withDrawn', 'withUpload', 'withColorSelect', 'withSubmit'] const STRING_PROPS = [ 'fontUrl', 'controlButtonsContainerClass', 'controlButtonsContainerStyle', 'saveButtonText', 'saveButtonClass', 'saveButtonStyle', 'saveButtonDisabledClass', 'saveButtonsDisabledStyle', 'undoButtonText', 'undoButtonClass', 'undoButtonStyle', 'clearButtonText', 'clearButtonClass', 'clearButtonStyle', 'textInputPlaceholder', 'textInputClass', 'textInputStyle', 'canvasClass', 'canvasStyle', 'typeButtonsContainerClass', 'typeButtonsContainerStyle', 'drawTypeButtonText', 'drawTypeButtonClass', 'drawTypeButtonStyle', 'drawTypeButtonActiveClass', 'drawTypeButtonActiveStyle', 'textTypeButtonText', 'textTypeButtonClass', 'textTypeButtonStyle', 'textTypeButtonActiveClass', 'textTypeButtonActiveStyle', 'uploadTypeButtonText', 'uploadTypeButtonClass', 'uploadTypeButtonStyle', 'uploadTypeButtonActiveClass', 'uploadTypeButtonActiveStyle', ] const ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES: Record = { saveButtonsDisabledStyle: 'data-save-button-disabled-style' } const attributeName = (prop: string) => ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES[prop] || `data-${prop.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (char) => `-${char.toLowerCase()}`)}` test.beforeAll(async () => { await build({ entryPoints: [path.join(__dirname, 'app.ts')], bundle: true, outfile: BUNDLE, define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"development"', __VUE_OPTIONS_API__: 'true', __VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__: 'false', __VUE_PROD_HYDRATION_MISMATCH_DETAILS__: 'false', }, logLevel: 'silent', }) }) test('every prop is rendered as its data attribute', async ({ page }) => { const props: Record = {} for (const prop of BOOLEAN_PROPS) props[prop] = prop === 'downloadOnSave' for (const prop of STRING_PROPS) props[prop] = `${prop}-value` await page.setContent('
') await page.evaluate((props) => ((window as any).props = props), props) await page.addScriptTag({ path: BUNDLE }) const el = page.locator('signature-maker') await expect(el).toHaveCount(1) for (const prop of BOOLEAN_PROPS) { await expect(el).toHaveAttribute(attributeName(prop), String(prop === 'downloadOnSave')) } for (const prop of STRING_PROPS) { await expect(el).toHaveAttribute(attributeName(prop), `${prop}-value`) } const names = await el.evaluate((node) => node.getAttributeNames().filter((name) => name.startsWith('data-'))) expect(names.sort()).toEqual([...BOOLEAN_PROPS, ...STRING_PROPS].map(attributeName).sort()) }) test('props that are undefined or empty are not rendered', async ({ page }) => { await page.setContent('
') await page.evaluate(() => ((window as any).props = { withUpload: undefined, saveButtonText: '', fontUrl: undefined })) await page.addScriptTag({ path: BUNDLE }) const el = page.locator('signature-maker') await expect(el).toHaveCount(1) await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-font-url') await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-with-upload') await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-save-button-text') await expect(page.locator('[data-target="saveButton"]')).toHaveText('Submit') await expect(page.locator('[data-target="uploadTypeButton"]')).toBeVisible() })

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "strict": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "emitDeclarationOnly": true,
    "outDir": "dist"
  },
  "include": ["src"]
}

import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test'

export default defineConfig({
	testDir: 'tests',
	forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
	retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
	reporter: 'list',
	projects: [{ name: 'chrome', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], channel: 'chrome' } }],
})

export { SignatureMaker, type SignatureDetail, type SignatureMakerElement } from './SignatureMaker'
export { SignatureMaker as default } from './SignatureMaker'

import { defineComponent, h, type PropType } from 'vue'
import '@docuseal/signature-maker-js'
import type { SignatureDetail, SignatureMakerElement } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-js'

export type { SignatureDetail, SignatureMakerElement }

const optionalString = { type: String as PropType<string>, required: false, default: undefined } as const
const optionalBoolean = { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean>, required: false, default: undefined } as const

const ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES: Record<string, string> = { saveButtonsDisabledStyle: 'data-save-button-disabled-style' }

const toAttributeName = (prop: string) => ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES[prop] || `data-${prop.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (char) => `-${char.toLowerCase()}`)}`

export const SignatureMaker = defineComponent({
	name: 'SignatureMaker',
	props: {
		modelValue: { type: String as PropType<string | null>, required: false, default: null },
		downloadOnSave: optionalBoolean,
		withTyped: optionalBoolean,
		withDrawn: optionalBoolean,
		withUpload: optionalBoolean,
		withColorSelect: optionalBoolean,
		withSubmit: optionalBoolean,
		fontUrl: optionalString,
		controlButtonsContainerClass: optionalString,
		controlButtonsContainerStyle: optionalString,
		saveButtonText: optionalString,
		saveButtonClass: optionalString,
		saveButtonStyle: optionalString,
		saveButtonDisabledClass: optionalString,
		saveButtonsDisabledStyle: optionalString,
		undoButtonText: optionalString,
		undoButtonClass: optionalString,
		undoButtonStyle: optionalString,
		clearButtonText: optionalString,
		clearButtonClass: optionalString,
		clearButtonStyle: optionalString,
		textInputPlaceholder: optionalString,
		textInputClass: optionalString,
		textInputStyle: optionalString,
		canvasClass: optionalString,
		canvasStyle: optionalString,
		typeButtonsContainerClass: optionalString,
		typeButtonsContainerStyle: optionalString,
		drawTypeButtonText: optionalString,
		drawTypeButtonClass: optionalString,
		drawTypeButtonStyle: optionalString,
		drawTypeButtonActiveClass: optionalString,
		drawTypeButtonActiveStyle: optionalString,
		textTypeButtonText: optionalString,
		textTypeButtonClass: optionalString,
		textTypeButtonStyle: optionalString,
		textTypeButtonActiveClass: optionalString,
		textTypeButtonActiveStyle: optionalString,
		uploadTypeButtonText: optionalString,
		uploadTypeButtonClass: optionalString,
		uploadTypeButtonStyle: optionalString,
		uploadTypeButtonActiveClass: optionalString,
		uploadTypeButtonActiveStyle: optionalString,
	},
	emits: {
		save: (detail: SignatureDetail) => !!detail,
		change: (detail: SignatureDetail) => !!detail,
		'update:model-value': (base64: string | null) => base64 === null || typeof base64 === 'string',
	},
	setup(props, { emit }) {
		return () => {
			const attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {
				onSave: (e: CustomEvent<SignatureDetail>) => emit('save', e.detail),
				onChange: (e: CustomEvent<SignatureDetail>) => {
					emit('change', e.detail)
					emit('update:model-value', e.detail.base64)
				},
			}

			for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
				if (key !== 'modelValue' && value !== undefined && value !== '') attributes[toAttributeName(key)] = String(value)
			}

			return h('signature-maker', attributes)
		}
	},
})

export default SignatureMaker
